authority.official_broad_domain_meaning: Определять словообразовательные связи и способы образования слов.
authority.official_program_provenance: EDSOO Federal Working Program Russian 5-9, 2025 / PUBLIC_OFFICIAL_PDF

decisions.label_ru: Новое слово или новая форма: главный первый выбор
decisions.boundary_guard: Establish whether a new lexeme exists versus only an inflectional or grammatical form before assigning any derivational method; visible ending or letter changes alone are insufficient, and this bounded semantic does not grant derivational-method or orthographic mastery.

Determine the formation method relative to the nearest producing word or base by comparing producing and derived bases; presence of a prefix or suffix alone is insufficient, non-suffixal analysis requires positive derivational evidence, and part-of-speech transition requires functional and semantic proof.

Derivational analysis identifies the immediate producing word and formation step, while a derivational chain requires each adjacent step to be directly motivated; this is not the same as morphemic parsing, and remote common-root kinship cannot skip intermediate derivational steps.

explicit_non_acceptances.reason: The broad official domain establishes word-formation scope but does not prove one-to-one object binding for the three bounded components; object accounting remains unchanged.
Morphemic analysis is a prerequisite and evidence source for word-formation analysis but does not itself grant derivational mastery.
Using derivational structure to explain spelling does not by itself grant exact orthographic mastery.

explicit_non_acceptances.semantic_or_object_ref: method identification without nearest producing-base comparison
explicit_non_acceptances.reason: A visible affix or common root is insufficient to assign a formation method without proving the immediate producing relation.
